svg.title: 마이온도 버건디 도트 패턴 · 대각선 반영
svg.desc: Background reconstruction using the observed ribbed-dot arrangement, including the confirmed 135-degree diagonal motif. The 6 by 6 block is a reconstructed background tile, not a verified manufacturing repeat. Transparent background. Native editable elliptical vectors. Five tapered elliptical ribs per dot.
